info.name: Mindy — Phase 16 business bell notifications
info.description: Start with Authentication: choose Login Student OR Login Mentor, then Get current user before notification requests. Set student_email/student_password or mentor_email/mentor_password in your local Postman environment; keep credentials private and do not export them. The cookie jar uses the most recently logged-in account for the host; do not run both logins expecting separate sessions. Requires Phase 16 migration, NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED and activated producers. Business WebSocket: namespace /notifications, path /ws/notifications, websocket only. Never store tickets or access tokens in collection variables/files.

item.name: Authentication — choose one login
item.description: Choose the intended role, then Get current user. Postman automatically retains access_token/refresh_token in its cookie jar for the same host. Switching login switches the actor for subsequent inbox requests.

exec: pm.test('Logged in as STUDENT', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('STUDENT'); pm.expect(body.accessTokenExpiresAt).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('Session cookies returned', () => { const cookies = pm.response.headers.all().filter(h => h.key.toLowerCase() === 'set-cookie').map(h => h.value); pm.expect(cookies.some(c => c.startsWith('access_token='))).to.eql(true); pm.expect(cookies.some(c => c.startsWith('refresh_token='))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Logged in as MENTOR', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('MENTOR'); pm.expect(body.accessTokenExpiresAt).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('Session cookies returned', () => { const cookies = pm.response.headers.all().filter(h => h.key.toLowerCase() === 'set-cookie').map(h => h.value); pm.expect(cookies.some(c => c.startsWith('access_token='))).to.eql(true); pm.expect(cookies.some(c => c.startsWith('refresh_token='))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Cookie session is authenticated', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const user = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(user.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(['STUDENT', 'MENTOR']).to.include(user.role); });

pm.test('200 with business rows', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); body.data.forEach(n => pm.expect(n.type).not.to.eql('CHAT_MESSAGE')); pm.expect(body.meta.hasMore).to.be.a('boolean'); });

pm.test('Short lived ticket returned without persistence', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.ticket).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(Date.parse(body.expiresAt) - Date.now()).to.be.at.most(61000); });
